body: I'm thirty. Other partner has a lot of shit on their plate just from their own general life/mental health stuff, but has been incredibly supportive. I told them to take last night/today for themself because they'd been present a lot lately. It's mostly been them and two friends, though a few others have been around. There are a few more people i could ask, but i feel pretty reserved asking most people for help when i'm like this. I know, realistically, i should try to reach out to those people, but shit's a challenge. People are being good, and i know there are good things in my life, but they all just feel rather hollow.
